input.rationale: Promote the store-type-independence result to durable Fact knowledge tied to the completed execution, since it is the reusable conclusion for anyone fixing or reviewing this defect: the stall is not caused by retained above-snapshot log bytes.

knowledge.statement: In the retained 3-node in-memory execution (CheckRun ed8023e758ae49bc93676179f4ae489c), the post-snapshot catch-up stall occurred for both log-store monotonicity branches: with a non-monotonic InmemStore the isolated follower stayed at applied index 45 while the leader commit index was 55 (event 3, stalled=true, isolated_caught_up=false), and with MockMonotonicLogStore, whose removeOldLogs deletes the above-snapshot log bytes during installSnapshot, it still stayed at applied index 45 with old_last_after=223 (event 5, stalled=true, isolated_caught_up=false). The control whose log ended at or below the snapshot index reached applied index 55 (event 1, isolated_caught_up=true).
knowledge.conditions: Single process, three real Raft instances over InmemTransport with FileSnapshotStore; ProtocolVersion=3; HeartbeatTimeout=ElectionTimeout=LeaderLeaseTimeout=300ms; TrailingLogs=0; the isolated node's above-snapshot suffix was produced by real uncommitted Apply calls on the old leader before it stepped down; only live catch-up was measured.

result.summary: Completion status; no new semantic change (expected no_change). No necessary gaps remain and the investigation is explained. Sourced defect (concluded): a follower that installs a snapshot at index S while its persisted log still ends above S never accepts the leader's PrevLogEntry=S check and never converges. installSnapshot (raft.go:1814-1953) resets lastApplied/lastSnapshot/configuration and removes or compacts logs at or below req.LastLogIndex but never truncates above it and never calls setLastLog, so getLastEntry (state.go:167-174) keeps reporting the cached above-snapshot index/term; appendEntries (raft.go:1475-1502) rejects with NoRetryBackoff; replicateTo (replication.go:222-260) lowers nextIndex to ErrLogNotFound and sendLatestSnapshot (replication.go:299-383) re-sends the same snapshot. Retained evidence: CheckRun 2322bd7884b749f89c3101f04bc82e78 (control holds; case violated, valid witness 3) and CheckRun ed8023e758ae49bc93676179f4ae489c (monotonic store also violated, witness 5, so the stall persists after removeOldLogs deletes the bytes — cause is the un-reset cached last-log state, not retained bytes). Boundaries preserved: single-process in-memory transport/stores, live catch-up only, progress only with no safety claim, no restart/recovery coverage. This is not an early stop declaration; the run simply has no remaining necessary work and its budget is expiring.
